_note: Sub-case spray-less: a valid HTTP 200 player-stats response whose spray_chart_data is null (the scorekeeper did not chart). Per ScoutingSprayChartCrawler this is a fetch SUCCESS (games_crawled+1, errors=0); the loader skips it gracefully (0 rows). Served for ALL games in the degraded scenario, so spray_status='completed' (null != error, TN-1/TN-7) and spray_games_with_data=0.
